summary: The note is a news-style story claiming that an unprecedented surge in solar tsunamis since September 2023 coincides with structured radio bursts detected by SETI Institute's Project Sigma, prompting speculation about alien influence. It describes the October 17, 2023 flare, the monitoring by observatories, global decoding efforts, and collaborative initiatives and education responses. Scientists are described as cautious, with no definitive conclusions about an extraterrestrial link.
one_line: A news story claims a surge of solar tsunamis since September 2023 coincides with structured radio bursts, fueling speculation about alien influence.
key_facts: Solar tsunamis are caused by solar flares and coronal mass ejections (CMEs), eruptions of magnetized plasma.
Dr. Aria Sterling, Chief Solar Analyst at the Heliospheric Observatory in New Mexico, reports solar tsunamis travel at up to 750 kilometers per second.
Solar tsunami activity has been unusually frequent and intense since September 2023.
The SETI Institute's Project Sigma, led by exo-linguist Dr. Luciana Vega, intercepted radio bursts with a structured pattern atypical of known cosmic phenomena.
The timing of the radio bursts reportedly coincides with each subsequent solar tsunami, which is described as beyond current astrophysical models.
On October 17, 2023, the sun unleashed the most significant solar flare since the Carrington Event of 1859.
After the October 17 flare, solar tsunamis disrupted satellite communications and caused auroras visible as far south as the equator.
Dr. Vega's team noted the radio burst sequences contained prime number counts and Fibonacci series elements, considered hallmarks of intelligent design.
An international consortium of space agencies redirected orbital observatories such as the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) and the Parker Solar Probe to continuously monitor the sun.
Project Sigma is supported by cryptographers, mathematicians, and linguists worldwide working to decode the signals.
Universities report record increases in applications for astrophysics, xenolinguistics, and heliophysics studies.
The Solar Crisis Think Tank and the SolarGuard Initiative are projects meant to foster cooperation and protect technological infrastructure.
Scientists have been cautious not to speculate on the meaning of the events or any interstellar ties.
